resources.string: Looking for a camera on the network…
No camera found on the network
The camera requires an RTSP password (Digest) — fill in the password field and connect again
Wait for the video to start before recording
Only if the camera requires a password (e.g. access over VPN). User: admin
Camera mounted upside down: up becomes down and left becomes right.
YooFree is completely free, ad-free and open source. If it saved you from the old ad-ridden app, buy me a coffee:
Protocol that controls the stream: the video\'s \"remote control\" over the network (SETUP, PLAY, TEARDOWN). YooFree talks to the camera directly over it, on your local network.
Carries the video and audio packets in real time, on top of RTSP (same TCP connection, interleaved channels).
The camera\'s video codec: compresses 1080p using little bandwidth. It is decoded straight on the phone\'s hardware.
Audio codec (A-law/µ-law) that these cameras transmit along with the video.
Pan/Tilt/Zoom — the commands that turn the camera (up, down, left, right).
Open standard for IP cameras. On this kind of camera the stream lives at the /onvif1 path (and /onvif2 for the secondary stream).
Description of the stream the camera returns in DESCRIBE: which tracks exist (video, audio) and the URI of each one.
Challenge-based authentication used when the camera has an RTSP password: the password never travels in plain text.
Keyframe that restarts decoding. The app waits for an IDR before drawing — that is why the image starts clean.
Encrypted tunnel that puts the phone \"inside\" your home network, so you can reach the camera from outside without exposing anything to the internet.
If the camera freezes or the image stays black, send the report: it opens a GitHub issue already filled with the app event log (no personal data — the password is never included).
No browser available to open the issue
GPL-3.0 — no cloud, no account, no ads.
YooFree automatic report (bug/camera frozen or black)
